actual.positive_precursor: A weighted shifted-square estimate controls the kinetic form growth by 1+C|delta| after q^2 is absorbed into 1+q^4. The onsite subflow is tensor-local, and the exact bond kick enlarges support by at most one graph layer.
actual.split: H=sum_x h_x+V_cross, V_cross=-c sum_<xy>q_x.q_y. The exact finite-volume bond kick factorizes over all edges and sends q_x to q_x and p_x to p_x+delta c sum_(y~x)q_y; its inverse is the negative step.

assertions.actual: EXP-000781 instantiates Kozitsky--Pasurek Theorems 3.1--3.3 for exact Q3LOCK. For a periodic finite volume define A_x=lambda_sigma||omega_x||_(C^sigma)^2+kappa||omega_x||_2^2. Condition the periodic law at x, apply their Lemma 4.1, integrate, and use generalized Holder with r_y=theta|J^Lambda_xy|/kappa and sum_y r_y<1. Finite-volume integrability then gives exp(n_x)<=exp(C)prod_y exp(r_y n_y), hence the conditional moment recursion n_x<=C+(theta/kappa)sum_y|J^Lambda_xy|n_y. Translation invariance, Jhat_Lambda<=6c, and kappa>theta Jhat_Lambda give n<=C/(1-theta Jhat_Lambda/kappa), uniformly in periodic volume and compact source by the EXP-000781 stability constants. Its arbitrary L2 exponential coefficient plus Holder control and the point-evaluation inequality imply sup phi(exp[a|q_x(0)|^2])<infinity for every a>0 at fixed beta.
